items.title: Our foster families take dogs that are not ready for adoption yet. Today that lives on a whiteboard and a group text, so nobody knows which foster home has room or when a dog is due back. I want a page listing each foster home, the animals staying there, how many more they can take, and the date each animal is due back. A dog in foster care must not appear on our public adoption list until the vet clears it.
